news.analysis: As a passer, McCord didn't do anything to severly hurt the Dolphins. He didn't do anything much to help them either. His 53% completion percentage is nothing to write home about, but on the bright side, he was able to get the ball to Malik Washington and Caleb Douglas enough to keep them relevant. It'll be tough to start any Dolphin next week against the Bills.
news.contents: Kyle McCord completed 17 of 32 passes for 209 yards and ran twice for four yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts. He also lost a fumble.

news.analysis: Henry was incredibly inefficient on Monday night, racking up just 20 yards on 15 total touches. He was able to get two goal-line touchdowns over the course of the game, which left him with a good fantasy total when paired with his five receptions. He should continue to get all of the work in this backfield moving forward, but his efficiency and Baltimore's offensive struggles will call into question his game-to-game consistency.

news.analysis: Miami placed Willis on injured reserve last week after an MRI showed his lingering groin issue had become a core muscle injury. He'll miss at least three more games. The team expected him back before the season ended, but potential surgery puts that return in doubt. He is only worth holding in deep superflex and 2QB leagues until there's an update. Kyle McCord remains Miami's starter.
